questions.q:
Select the appropriate option for the given blank.

A/An ____________ stone temple is situated near the river.
questions.s:
If a noun in a sentence is described in different aspects by more than one adjective, the adjectives must follow a set sequence or order as stated below:

Opinion - > Size - > Other qualities - >Age - >Colour/Pattern - >Nationality - >Material - >Purpose

Example:

After debating between the two, she went with the tall slender red Japanese maple tree. [size, other qualities, colour, nationality, purpose]

The big blue football jersey fit the boy just right. [size, colour, purpose]

Here, 'size' is massive, 'other quality' is impressive, and 'colour' is red.

So, the correct sentence is - A massive, impressive red stone temple is situated near the river.

Hence, option (d) is correct.

questions.q:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined words in the given sentence.

Varun is handsome than his brother.
questions.s: The most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined words in the given sentence is 'more handsome than'. The error in the original sentence is the incorrect comparative form used. The comparative form of the adjective "handsome" should be used to compare two things. In this case, Varun is being compared to his brother. However, the sentence incorrectly uses "than" after "handsome," which is grammatically incorrect. The correct comparative form of "handsome" is "more handsome." Option (a) is incorrect because "much" is used to intensify adjectives or adverbs, not to form comparisons. Option (b) is incorrect because "most" is the superlative form of the adjective "handsome," which is used when comparing more than two items. However, the sentence only compares Varun to his brother. Option (d) is incorrect because it uses the preposition "to" instead of "than" in a comparison of inequality. The correct construction for comparisons of inequality with adjectives is "more ... than." Hence, (c) is the correct answer.

questions.q:
In the following sentence the underlined part contains an error. Alternatives to the underlined part are given as options. Select the correct alternative.

The sky appeared to be greyest after the storm.
questions.s:
The underlined word greyest is a superlative adjective, implying comparison among three or more items, which is not supported by the sentence context (no multiple items are compared). The sentence requires a simple adjective to describe the sky's appearance.

more grey: Comparative, implying comparison with another, not suitable without a specific comparison.

greyer: Comparative, also incorrect without a comparison.

most grey: Superlative, similar to "greyest," incorrect without multiple items.

grey: Base adjective, appropriate for a simple description: "The sky appeared to be grey after the storm."

Thus, grey is the correct alternative.

questions.q: The following sentence has been divided into parts. One of them may contain an error. Select the part that contains the error from the given options. If you don’t find any error, mark ‘No error’ as your answer.
o: on the ecosystem of wetlands
has a negatively effect
Human activity often
questions.s:
The error is in the segment: "has a negatively effect".

  • The word "negatively" is an adverb, but in this context, it is modifying a noun ("effect").

  • To correctly modify a noun, we need an adjective, not an adverb.

  • So, the correct phrase should be: "a negative effect" (where "negative" is an adjective).

Correct Sentence:
Human activity often has a negative effect on the ecosystem of wetlands.
